description: Investigate sales, dated alerts, Buy Box observations, FBA inventory, revenue and fees from your connected Limonene store. Ask for a weekly performance review or investigate a specific SKU, with data freshness and calculation limitations included. Read-only OAuth access is limited to one authorized store and can be revoked at any time. This plugin cannot change prices, ads, listings or orders. Requires a Limonene account with a connected, synchronized Amazon store.

defaultPrompt: Review my last seven days of Amazon sales and identify three issues worth investigating.
Check my FBA inventory risks and explain which products need attention.
Break down my revenue and Amazon fees, and explain which costs are missing from the profit calculation.
